title: Langdonia
description: The Langdonia Realm Modded Server Modpack. This is required to play on the modded realm.
body:
This is the modpack for the Langdonia Realm Modded Server.

Add the modpack in the Modrinth app to install the instance, and it will be ready to play. The major addition is the Create mod plus addons. Additional quality of life, terrain generation, and adventure mods are included for a fuller vanilla+ feel. 

Message me on Discord if you have any issues.
